name: Wuxi Commercial Mansion Grand Orient Co., Ltd.
summary: Wuxi Commercial Mansion Grand Orient Co., Ltd. engages in departmental store retail and healthcare businesses in China. The company is involved in the retail of department store merchandise and household appliances; the production and sale of food; and the provision of health services. It also engages in the sale of food, gold, and jewelry; the purchase of agricultural and sideline products; the retail of meat, eggs, aquatic products, and pre-cleaned vegetables; catering services; freight station operations; general road freight transportation; the repair and modification of gold jewelry; the installation and repair of household appliances; processing services for clothing and eyeglasses; co…
